title: Variants
body:
This mod adds new variants of vanilla blocks. All textures are designed to match the vanilla Minecraft style.
![Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3eacab08751da0315a85f8a8e133786511644d2.png)
(This is just a beta version of the mod, and the list of blocks will be expanded in the future.)
